still.note: DELIBERATELY STILL, 2026-08-20. Ryan: "Just the ones you can see the leaves of… Not the mountains or the distant pine trees that are barely nubs." A nub has no delicate part -- it is a silhouette, and swinging a silhouette reads as the mountain deforming, which is the summit lesson one notch closer. Authored per region because NO statistic separates these from the near trees: mark count, mark size and ink fraction all put s-compound-canopies with s-great-trees-upper. Wang Meng was not drawing them differently, he was drawing them smaller. evidence: living/evidence-which-canopies-have-leaves.png
